samples.question: The picture shows black closed loops on white paper, plus one red dot and one blue dot. Every black curve is a complete closed loop with no opening. Loops never touch or cross each other, and no dot touches a loop. A loop surrounds a dot when the dot lies inside that loop; loops that do not contain the dot do not count, no matter how near they are. Which dot is surrounded by more loops? Answer red, blue, or same.
